about.description: CRAB is a continuation of Mini Wallpaper BETA. The wallpaper engine (video playback through mpv in a desktop window) is unchanged — the interface and branding are new.
about.title: About
changelog.empty: No entries in the update history.
changelog.title: Update history
changes.a-crab-has-been-updated-to-versi: A "CRAB has been updated to version X.X.X" message after the files are replaced, together with a "What's new?" window listing the changes of that version.
changes.a-stop-button-that-restores-the-: A "Stop" button that restores the static system wallpaper.
changes.about-tab-with-the-logo-the-name: "About" tab with the logo, the name, the version and a description.
changes.an-fps-slider-15-60-limiting-the: An FPS slider (15–60) limiting the number of rendered frames.
changes.automatic-detection-of-the-syste: Automatic detection of the system language on first start (Polish system leads to Polish, every other system leads to English).
changes.background-playback-that-does-no: Background playback that does not capture user input.
changes.crab-never-downloads-or-runs-cod: CRAB never downloads or runs code from the network. Updates are installed manually; the program only reports that they are available.
changes.dark-crab-interface-with-a-sideb: Dark CRAB interface with a sidebar and navigation.
changes.interface-language-picker-in-set: Interface language picker in Settings: Polish and English. The change applies immediately, without restarting the application, and is saved in `config.json`.
changes.mouse-and-keyboard-transparency-: Mouse and keyboard transparency and a layer below the desktop icons.
changes.my-wallpapers-tab-with-a-large-v: "My wallpapers" tab with a large video preview, file picker, "Set as wallpaper" and "Stop" buttons and an FPS slider.
changes.notification-area-icon-open-mini: Notification area icon: "Open Mini Wallpaper" became "Open CRAB".
changes.picking-a-video-file-mp4-webm-mk: Picking a video file (MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV, AVI).
changes.preview-generated-from-the-first: Preview generated from the first frame of the file and stored in the cache.
changes.program-name-mini-wallpaper-beca: Program name: Mini Wallpaper became CRAB (Custom Responsive Animated Backgrounds).
changes.recent-tab-with-a-file-list-and-: "Recent" tab with a file list and a "Set" button.
changes.release-history-read-from-github: Release history read from GitHub Releases, from the local `CHANGELOG.md` as a fallback and from the cache in `~/.cache/crab/releases.json`.
changes.remembering-the-last-file-and-th: Remembering the last file and the FPS value.
changes.running-in-the-background-closin: Running in the background: closing the window does not stop the wallpaper, and the notification area icon carries a play, resume and quit menu.
changes.setting-a-video-as-an-animated-d: Setting a video as an animated desktop wallpaper.
changes.settings-migration-on-first-star: Settings migration: on first start the old Mini Wallpaper configuration directory is read.
changes.settings-tab-with-information-ab: "Settings" tab with information about the session, the engine, the decoding mode, the configuration path and the notification area icon.
changes.the-documentation-describes-the-: The documentation describes the X11 requirement and the reason why Wayland is not supported.
changes.the-notification-area-menu-and-e: The notification area menu and every label translated into the chosen language.
changes.the-recent-file-list-is-stored-i: The recent file list is stored in the configuration.
changes.translation-system-in-the-locale: Translation system in the `locales/` directory (JSON files, one per language); a new language is a new file, with no changes to the application code.
changes.update-checking-in-the-backgroun: Update checking in the background through the GitHub Releases API.
changes.update-history-page-with-a-list-: "Update history" page with a list of releases from newest to oldest.
changes.updates-section-in-settings-a-ch: "Updates" section in Settings: a "Check for updates" button, the current version and information about an available newer version.
changes.wallpaper-engine-a-net-wm-window: Wallpaper engine: a `_NET_WM_WINDOW_TYPE_DESKTOP` window, playback through mpv in a `GtkSocket`, software decoding, looping, the FPS filter, input transparency and placement below the desktop icon window.
